App.Title: UEBulkExport
App.Tagline: Bulk export for Unreal Engine containers
Export.Title: Export
Export.Source.Title: Game
Export.Source.Help: The game's root folder is enough: the folder with the containers (Content\Paks) is found inside it. A single .utoc or .pak file works too, and you can drop either onto the window.
Export.Engine.Detecting: Reading the engine version from the game…
Export.Engine.Unsupported: The game uses Unreal Engine {0}, which this version of the reader does not know yet. Choose the closest version below.
Export.Engine.NotDetected: The engine version could not be read from the game. Choose it below.
Export.Game.Help: The engine version decides how the containers are read. It is taken from the game executable; change it only if the game uses a modified engine or the export fails.
Export.Game.Label: Engine version
Export.Aes.Label: AES keys
Export.Aes.Required: {0} container(s) are encrypted. Add the game's AES key to read them.
Export.Aes.Help: One key per line, as 0x followed by 64 hex digits. To use a key for one container only, write <container GUID>:0x…
Export.Scan.Missing: This folder or file does not exist.
Export.Scan.Retry.Hint: Reads the containers again, for example after replacing game files.
Export.Mode.Title: What do you want to get?
Export.Out.Title: Save to
Export.Out.OverwriteWarning: “Start over” is on: files already in the output folder are written again.
Export.Out.Hint: Fully completed entries are journalled, so an interrupted export can resume safely.
Mode.Legacy.Title: Game packages
Mode.Legacy.Desc: Cooked .uasset and .umap files with their data, as the game stores them.
Mode.Legacy.Details: Extracts cooked .uasset / .umap packages together with their .uexp / .ubulk / .uptnl payloads. IoStore packages are converted to the classic cooked layout with retoc. No mappings file needed. Note: these are cooked packages, not editable source assets.
Mode.Full.Title: Converted files
Mode.Full.Desc: PNG textures, glTF meshes, audio and readable JSON.
Mode.Full.Details: Parses every package and writes textures as PNG, meshes as glTF, animations, sounds, levels and JSON property dumps. UE5 games usually need a mappings file (.usmap).
Mode.Json.Title: Data for comparison
Mode.Json.Desc: Property dumps only: small, fast, easy to compare between builds.
Mode.Json.Details: Writes only the serialized properties as JSON. Ideal for diffing two versions of a game. UE5 games usually need a mappings file (.usmap).
Mode.Raw.Title: Exact copy
Mode.Raw.Desc: Every container entry byte for byte, nothing converted.
Mode.Raw.Details: Byte-exact copy of every container entry. No parsing and no mappings. IoStore packages stay in the Zen layout and cannot be opened by the Unreal Editor as they are.
Export.Usmap.Label: Mappings (.usmap)
Export.Usmap.Help: Shipping UE5 games store properties without names, and a mappings file puts them back. It is picked up automatically when a single .usmap lies next to the containers.
Export.Usmap.NotFound: The chosen mappings file does not exist.
Export.Usmap.Ambiguous: Several .usmap files lie next to the game. Choose one.
Export.Usmap.Missing: No mappings file found. UE5 games usually need one for this result.
Export.Usmap.Optional: Not needed for most UE4 games.
Export.Options.Title: Export options
Export.Filters.Title: Filters
Export.Filters.Hint: Matched against the container path, e.g. ^Engine/ to drop stock engine content. Pick folders in the Browser tab to fill these in.
Export.Filters.LegacyIoStore: Filters do not apply to Game packages from IoStore containers: retoc converts the whole container.
Export.What.Title: What to write
Export.Formats.Title: Formats
Opt.NoWorlds.Hint: Levels are written as USD and pull in a copy of every mesh they reference. Large.
Opt.Materials.Hint: Meshes pull in their materials and textures. Slower; resume with 1 thread if it stalls.
Opt.NoAudioConvert: Do not convert BINKA / ADPCM audio to .wav
Opt.Overwrite.Hint: By default a second run into the same folder only does what is missing.
Export.Tools.Title: Helper tools
Export.Tools.Hint: Found or downloaded automatically. Set a path only to use your own copy.
Tools.Retoc.Hint: Converts IoStore packages to the cooked layout. A verified copy is downloaded on Windows x64.
Tools.Vgmstream.Hint: Turns BINKA / ADPCM audio into .wav. Never downloaded; supply it yourself.
Migrate.Title: Migrate to Unreal Engine
Migrate.Subtitle: Rebuild supported assets from a UE4 or UE5 cooked dump inside your own Unreal project.
Migrate.Limitations: Cooking removed editor-only data for good. Meshes, textures and sound can be rebuilt; Blueprint graphs, materials, levels and Niagara systems cannot. UE Viewer's .psa animations are not imported.
Migrate.Source.Title: Source dump
Migrate.Source.Help: A folder of cooked .uasset files from a UE 4.0–4.27 or UE 5.0–5.8 game, for example the result of a Game packages export. The dump is only read, never changed.
Migrate.Source.Hint: glTF, FBX, OBJ, images and audio already in the folder are imported directly.
Migrate.SourceVersion.Hint: The exact engine version the dump was built with (UE 4.0–4.27 or UE 5.0–5.8).
Migrate.Target.Title: Target project
Migrate.Detect.Hint: Finds UE Viewer and the matching Unreal Editor, and suggests a recently used project if none is set. Paths you typed are never replaced.

Migrate.Destination.Label: Content folder
Migrate.Destination.Hint: Where the assets appear in the project, as an Unreal path that starts with /Game, for example /Game/Migrated.
Migrate.Overwrite.Hint: Off: assets already in the project are left untouched, so an interrupted migration can resume.

Migrate.Mappings.Hint: Optional. Without mappings the program will try to read the UE5 dump, but some or all assets may fail. If selected, use mappings from the exact same game build.

Migrate.Editor.Hint: Use the editor of the project's engine version. The project needs the Python Editor Script Plugin enabled.

About.Title: About
About.Subtitle: What this is, what it is built on, and what it is not.
About.Description: UEBulkExport extracts an entire Unreal Engine container — every .pak, .utoc and .ucas — into one folder, mirroring the game's directory tree. It is the “take everything” button that asset browsers deliberately leave out.
About.BuiltOn.Text: Container reading and asset conversion are done by CUE4Parse and CUE4Parse-Conversion (Apache-2.0). IoStore packages are converted to the cooked layout by retoc (MIT). UEBulkExport is the orchestration on top: discovery, scheduling, resumable runs, diagnostics and this window.
About.NotUncooker: This is not an uncooker. Cooking removes editor-only data; extracted packages are the cooked originals, not editable source assets. Blueprint graphs cannot be recovered.
About.License.Text: Apache License 2.0. Third-party components and their licenses are listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
About.Legal.Text: This tool reads files you explicitly select or accepts registration events from your probe-enabled test build that it explicitly launches. It does not attach, inject code, read another process's memory, or bypass DRM or anti-cheat. What you may do with the output is governed by the source material's licence. Not affiliated with Epic Games, CUE4Parse, FModel or UE4SS. “Unreal” and “Unreal Engine” are trademarks of Epic Games, Inc.
